one_liner: Remember anyone, think through an idea, and find the right person when they can help.
category: personal contact memory and grounded relationship recall for independent operators
supersedes: Descriptions of the one-plane Hinge UI, a relationship-to-revenue engine, overnight drafted Moves, or $30/$79 tiers are retired.
primary_user: Fractional executives and independent operators who meet useful people but do not want to maintain a CRM.
anti_icp: Sales teams needing deal stages, seat management, pipeline administration, or automated outreach.
active_flow: People: browse everyone, ask who could help, add one person, or bring in contacts.
Ideas: start from a rough thought or reopen an earlier idea.
You: manage profile, connected contacts, reminders, privacy, and account settings.
Circle preserves raw contact input and uses the existing dedupe pipeline.
Circle returns saved people with reasons grounded in stored evidence.
live: Text, link, email, voice, photo, supported device-contact, and Android PWA share intake
Optional meeting-context tag and complete contact browsing
LinkedIn/CRM file, Google, and Microsoft import entry points
Recent idea history, new idea capture, and exact-run reopen
Exact saved-name recall without an LLM or paid search dependency
Provider-backed broader search and idea ranking with grounded local recovery
not_shipped: Native iOS share-sheet intake or an official Apple Shortcut
Guaranteed interest, availability, or relationship strength
trust: Nothing saves until the user taps the save action.
Exact saved-name recall degrades independently of remote AI providers.
Circle never sends a message automatically.

pricing.note: Wider network search may be plan-gated. Exact recall of a person already saved is not.
